gold.subject: GF-B/V model
gold.object: bacterial versus viral disease with high accuracy
gold.condition: internal fivefold cross-validation
gold.evidence: The Global Fever-Bacterial/Viral (GF-B/V) model classified bacterial from viral disease with high accuracy when internally validated using fivefold cross-validation: AUROC of 0.93, sensitivity of 84.2% (95% CI 75.6–90.7), specificity of 94.7% (95% CI 88.6–97.7), and overall accuracy of 89.7% (95% CI 85.0–93.4).
